channel.title: Finality
channel.description: Finality reports crypto news: protocol upgrades, network incidents, exchange and stablecoin developments, regulation and the projects shaping blockchain.

item.title: Solana Activates Alpenglow, Replacing TowerBFT
item.description: Solana activated Alpenglow on mainnet, replacing TowerBFT with certificate-based voting that targets finality in about 150 milliseconds for confirmed blocks.

item.title: HSBC RedCoin starts phased rollout to PayMe users
item.description: HSBC has begun a phased PayMe rollout of its HKD stablecoin, giving 3.3 million users access to app-based transfers and merchant payments under HKMA licensing.

item.title: Fermi swap: How the router chooses a trading route
item.description: Fermi swap routing can select one venue, pin execution to a chosen venue or split an order; each mode changes how quotes, fallback and output limits work.

item.title: Wall Street’s blockchain shift reaches bank payments and securities
item.description: At Money 20/20, banks and market infrastructure firms described live blockchain services and a coming DTC tokenization rollout, extending transfers beyond banking hours.

item.title: HSBC launches RedCoin on PayMe for 3.3 million users
item.description: HSBC launched RedCoin on PayMe, opening wallet activation to 3.3 million users for transfers and merchant payments as it brings regulated HKD tokens to retail payments.

item.title: OCC rule leaves stablecoin platform rewards under case-by-case review
item.description: The OCC’s GENIUS Act rule bars issuers from paying yield to holders but leaves platform rewards to a facts-and-circumstances review, with no blanket safe harbor.

item.title: Solana Token Accounts and the Mechanics of a First Trade
item.description: A first Solana trade moves value through mint-specific token accounts and a signed, atomic transaction; learn what the wallet creates, approves and can reject.

item.title: OCC leaves stablecoin rewards open to case-by-case review
item.description: The OCC finalized its GENIUS Act rules without a blanket ban on exchange-paid stablecoin rewards, but issuer-linked payments can still breach the yield prohibition.

item.title: Approve a Crypto Swap Quote Before Its Deadline
item.description: A quote is an estimate, not an order: check its minimum output and route, grant only the needed token allowance, then sign the swap before its deadline.

item.title: OCC leaves stablecoin rewards to case-by-case review
item.description: The OCC's GENIUS Act rule keeps direct issuer yield barred but leaves exchange rewards to case-by-case review, with no safe harbor as it takes effect in 2027.

item.title: Solana activates Alpenglow consensus, targeting 150ms finality
item.description: Solana activated Alpenglow on mainnet, replacing TowerBFT’s vote transactions with direct validator certificates to target faster finality without changing wallets or fees.

item.title: Trace a Mantle Deposit That Has Not Arrived
item.description: Trace a missing Mantle deposit from its Ethereum receipt to the destination message, then isolate approval-only, failed, pending and misdirected transfers.

item.title: Cancel a Partially Filled Limit Order Without Losing Track
item.description: A partial fill changes how much of your order remains executable. Check the settled amount, cancel the remainder, and verify the final state before replacing it.

item.title: How zerofi bridges Monero, and why Bitcoin is not supported
item.description: ZeroFi currently wraps Monero into zXMR on Ethereum Sepolia through bonded-node custody; Bitcoin is not supported, and the route remains a testnet flow.

item.title: Horizen EON Bridge After Shutdown: What Still Works
item.description: Horizen EON stopped at a migration snapshot: eligible EOA ZEN moved to Base, while contract balances, wZEN and DeFi positions stayed outside the transfer.

item.title: Interactive Brokers Opens Ethereum Staking to Eligible Clients
item.description: Interactive Brokers has opened Ethereum staking to eligible clients through zerohash, with rewards set by network rules and unstaking subject to delays.

item.title: Solana Activates Alpenglow, Targeting 150ms Finality
item.description: Solana validators replaced TowerBFT with Alpenglow at slot 459,653,000, shifting votes into certificates and targeting finality in about 150 milliseconds.

item.title: Rango Bridge: what an integration adds to cross-chain swaps
item.description: Rango Bridge can add cross-chain route discovery and execution, but its value depends on whether your app can handle multi-step signing, fees and status tracking.

item.title: Choosing a super bridge route: fees, finality and asset form
item.description: Cross-chain routes trade settlement time, asset form and trust assumptions against cost; compare each route’s steps and destination outcome before signing.

item.title: Blockchain.com launches crypto options as it seeks US licenses
item.description: Blockchain.com has launched short-dated crypto options in supported markets, while seeking CFTC registrations that could enable regulated derivatives trading in the US.
